title: A robe and a prayer for Athena
intro: Helenus sends Hector to arrange a collective offering. The commands mix imperatives and infinitives.

notes.text: ἰθύς, direction / undertaking: acc sg; “in every enterprise.” μάχεσθαι … φρονέειν: in fighting and planning.
ἵστημι 2pl root aor imperative, stand firm; ἐρύκω reduplicated aor imperative 2pl, hold back / check; keep the army outside the gates.
πάντῃ, in every direction; ἐποίχομαι, go about: pres mid ptc nom pl.
πρίν + inf, before; πίπτω epic 2aor inf, = πεσεῖν. “Before they fall fleeing into the women's arms.”
δήϊος, enemy: dat pl; χάρμα, joy / cause of joy; γίγνομαι 2aor mid inf, still after πρίν.
ἐποτρύνω, urge: 2dual aor subj; “when you two have urged all the ranks.”
αὖθι, here / on the spot; μένω pres ptc nom pl, standing our ground.
τείρω, wear down: pres pass ptc nom pl; περ concessive, “hard pressed though we are.”
ἀναγκαίη, necessity; ἐπείγω, press / constrain: 3sg pres.
πόλινδε, to the city (-δε directional); μετέρχομαι, go to: uncontracted 2sg pres imperative.
συνάγω, gather: pres ptc nom fem sg; γεραιός, aged: acc fem pl, the elder women.
νηός = νεώς, temple; ἐν πόλει ἄκρῃ, in the citadel.
οἴγνυμι, open: aor act ptc nom fem sg; κληΐς, key: dat sg.
πέπλος, robe: acc sg; τίθημι aor act inf used as command, “let her lay [the robe].” Long intervening relative clause describes it.
χαρίεις, lovely / graceful: superlative nom masc sg with πέπλος; greatest and most cherished robe.
γόνυ, knee: dat pl; ἠΰκομος, lovely-haired: gen sg with Athena. Robe placed on the statue's knees.
ὑπισχνέομαι, promise: 2aor mid inf, another command; οἱ, to Athena.
Twelve yearling cattle, never goaded / unworked; ἦνις, yearling: acc pl ἤνις; ἠκέστης, ungoaded: acc pl.
ἱερεύω, sacrifice: epic fut inf, dependent on promise. ἐλεέω, pity: 3sg aor subj; “if she will take pity.”
ἄλοχος, wife: acc pl; νήπιος, infant / young; τέκνον, child.
ἀπέχω, keep away: 3sg 2aor act subj; purpose, + gen Ἰλίου. ἱρός = ἱερός, sacred.
αἰχμητής, spearman; μήστωρ, deviser / master: acc sg; φόβος, rout / panic: gen sg.
κάρτιστος = κράτιστος, strongest; metathesis of ρ. Acc + inf after φημι: “I say he has proved strongest.”
δείδω, fear: 1pl plup with impf sense; ὄρχαμος, leader / chief: acc sg.
ἐξ + ἔμμεναι (= εἶναι), “to be born of a goddess”; gen θεᾶς. Achilles is Thetis' son.
λίην, exceedingly; μαίνομαι, rage; ἰσοφαρίζω, match / equal: pres inf, μένος acc of respect, in strength.
κασίγνητος, brother: dat sg; ἀπιθέω, disobey: 3sg aor, negated. Helenus is Hector's brother.
ὄχεα, chariot: gen pl; ἅλλομαι, leap: 3sg root aor mid; χαμᾶζε, to the ground.
πάλλω, brandish: pres ptc; οἴχομαι, go: 3sg impf; δοῦρα, spears.
ὀτρύνω, urge: pres ptc; ἐγείρω, rouse: 3sg impf; φύλοπις, battle-din: acc sg.
